description: Propose labels, flags, corrections and mappings on rows of the caller's datasets (Shopify orders, Google Ads campaigns, uploads) without touching the source, and accept or reject them.

action.description: Which operation to run. propose_column = a new label column, needs dataset_id, column, values; propose_flags = flag rows, needs dataset_id, rows; propose_corrections = corrected values for cells, needs dataset_id, corrections; propose_mappings = map raw values to clean ones, needs dataset_id, column, mappings; accept = accept proposals into the overlay, needs dataset_id, ids; reject = reject proposals, needs dataset_id, ids.

column.description: propose_column: New column name: lower case letters, digits and _, not an existing source column (e.g. "topic") propose_mappings: The source column whose values are mapped

corrections.description: One entry per cell: {row_key, column, value, reason}

column.description: The source column of the cell

reason.description: Why, in one sentence (where the right value comes from, what looks wrong)

row_key.description: The _row_key of the row, from get_data action "query" with overlay="with_overlay"

value.description: The new value for this row or cell

format.description: Output wire format for this MCP call. Default 'toon' (Token-Oriented Notation, fewest tokens, best for tabular rows). 'compact' = minified JSON. 'json' = pretty JSON for readability. The REST API always returns JSON regardless.

ids.description: accept: Proposal ids from a propose_* answer or my_workspace action "proposals" reject: Proposal ids

mappings.description: One entry per source value: {source_value, value (the canonical value), reason}

reason.description: Why, in one sentence (where the right value comes from, what looks wrong)

source_value.description: The value exactly as the source holds it

reason.description: Why, applied to every entry without its own reason

rows.description: One entry per flagged row: {row_key, column? (a single cell), reason}

column.description: Only this cell (a source column); omit to flag the whole row

reason.description: Why, in one sentence (where the right value comes from, what looks wrong)

row_key.description: The _row_key of the row, from get_data action "query" with overlay="with_overlay"

values.description: One entry per row: {row_key, value, reason?}

reason.description: Why, in one sentence (where the right value comes from, what looks wrong)

row_key.description: The _row_key of the row, from get_data action "query" with overlay="with_overlay"

value.description: The new value for this row or cell

name: proposals
